tasks.title: Align Blocks
tasks.summary: Align 3 cubes in a straight line using a ruler.
success_criteria: All objects still on table (not fallen)
All cubes at table surface height
Three cubes are collinear within 1cm tolerance
Minimum 3cm separation between furthest cubes
tasks.instruction: Align the three cubes perfectly in a straight line.

tasks.title: Retrieve Cube
tasks.summary: Retrieve a cube from a deep narrow container and place it on a target area.
success_criteria: Cube is on the table surface (z within tolerance of TABLE_Z)
Cube is outside the container (2D footprint overlap with container < 50%)
Cube's 2D footprint overlaps target area by at least 50%
Objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Retrieve the cube from the container and place it on the green target area.

tasks.title: Gap Retrieve
tasks.summary: Retrieve a lemon from a narrow gap and place it on a target area.
success_criteria: Lemon is on the table surface (z within tolerance of TABLE_Z)
Lemon's 2D footprint overlaps target area by at least 80%
Objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Place the lemon on the green target area.

tasks.title: Pinch Card
tasks.summary: Pick up a bank card from a small table surface using an eraser.
success_criteria: Bank card's 2D footprint overlaps target area by at least 50%
Bank card is resting on the target surface (not floating)
Bank card is not being held by either gripper
tasks.instruction: Pick the bank card up from the 'small table' surface.

tasks.title: Roll Up Ball
tasks.summary: Move a box into a basket using an inclined plane.
success_criteria: Box is completely inside the basket's bounding box
Box and basket are on the table
tasks.instruction: Move the box into the basket.

tasks.title: Dominos
tasks.summary: Push the red block onto the target area using a domino chain effect.
success_criteria: Red block's 2D footprint overlaps target area by at least 50%
tasks.instruction: Push the red block onto the green target area.

tasks.title: Stand Pages
tasks.summary: Assemble two pages using a stabilizing bar to create a standing hinge structure.
success_criteria: Both pages are standing upright (rotation about x or y close to 90 degrees)
Both pages are on the table surface
Both pages are within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Assemble the two pages using the stabilizing bar to create a standing hinge structure.

tasks.title: Round Dough Sheet
tasks.summary: Flatten a dough ball and make a perfect round sheet.
success_criteria: At least 95% of particles are within table bounds
Dough height (z_95 - z_5) ≤ 0.035m (must be genuinely flattened, not just gravity-settled ~4.4cm)
At least 70% of particles within the target cylinder (radius ~0.053m, height 0.03m)
XY convex hull circularity ≥ 0.85 (4π·Area/Perimeter² == 1 for perfect circle)
tasks.instruction: Flattern the dough ball and make a perfect round sheet

tasks.title: Hold Cup
tasks.summary: Put a cup on a sloped target area without it sliding down.
success_criteria: Cup's 2D footprint overlaps target area by at least 50%
Cup is stable with near-zero linear velocity
Cup is upright (tilt from vertical <= 20 degrees)
Cup remains within table bounds
Cup is not being held by either gripper
tasks.instruction: Put the cup on the green target area on the slope without sliding down.

tasks.title: Collect Screws
tasks.summary: Collect a screw into a container using a dustpan.
success_criteria: Screw is within the container's bounding box
Screw is still on the table (not fallen off)
tasks.instruction: Collect the screw into the container

tasks.title: Place Tall Box
tasks.summary: Move a tall box onto a target area under a beam obstacle.
success_criteria: Tall box overlaps target area by at least 80%
Both objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Move the rectangular box onto the green target area.

tasks.title: Ball Into Bottle
tasks.summary: Transfer a ball from a container into a bottle using a funnel.
success_criteria: Ball is fully inside the bottle's bounding box
Ball is not touching the table
tasks.instruction: Transfer the ball from the blue container into the red bottle.

tasks.title: Cover With Lid
tasks.summary: Cover a pot precisely using the correct sized lid.
success_criteria: Exactly one lid is above the pot
Lid overlaps pot by at least 80%
Lid size is appropriate (85%-140% of pot area)
tasks.instruction: Cover the pot precisely using one lid.

tasks.title: Stack Cubes
tasks.summary: Build a stable two-layer stack so the red cube is above the green marker.
success_criteria: Base cubes are on the table and touching with >= 50% face overlap
Apex cube sits on top of base cubes
Apex cube center is within tolerance of target marker
Apex-target overlap >= 20%
tasks.instruction: Build a stable two-layer stack so the red cube's center is above the green colored dot.

tasks.title: Separate Marbles And Sand
tasks.summary: Separate marbles from sand using a colander over a bowl.
success_criteria: All five marbles are inside the jar's 3D AABB
At least 80% of sand particles are outside the jar's 3D AABB
tasks.instruction: Remove sand from the jar and keep the marbles in the jar.

tasks.title: Stand Bulb
tasks.summary: Stand a tall object with curved bottom stably within a target area.
success_criteria: Tall object overlaps target patch by at least 80%
Tall object is upright (Z extent dominates XY extents)
Tall object is stable (low velocity)
Objects remain within table bounds
Tall object is not being held
tasks.instruction: Stand the tall object with curved bottom stably within the green target area.

tasks.title: Ball Onto Tower
tasks.summary: Place the ball stably on top of the tower.
success_criteria: Ball is stable (low velocity)
Ball is on top of the tower base (XY projection over base footprint)
Ball center is above the top of the tower base
Ball is not being held by either gripper
tasks.instruction: Place the ball stably on top of the tower.

tasks.title: Cylinder Through Hole
tasks.summary: Insert a cylindrical peg through a matching hole plate.
success_criteria: At least half the peg length has passed through the hole plate
Peg straddles the plate thickness (part above, part below)
Peg lies over the collection zone
Peg remains within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Insert the long rod through the opening so it rests over the green colored patch.

tasks.title: Stack Bowls
tasks.summary: Nest the smaller bowl concentrically inside the larger one.
success_criteria: Medium bowl's 2D center is within 1cm of large bowl's center
Both bowls remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Nest the smaller bowl concentrically inside the larger one.

tasks.title: Ball Into Jar
tasks.summary: Put the foam ball fully into the jar.
success_criteria: At least 90% of foam ball particles lie inside the glass jar's axis-aligned bounding box (rigid fallback: the ball's AABB is fully contained in the jar's)
Objects haven't fallen off the table
tasks.instruction: Put the foam ball fully into the jar.

tasks.title: Seal Colander
tasks.summary: Make a perforated container hold water.
success_criteria: Over 10% of water particles are inside the perforated container
Container hasn't fallen off the table
tasks.instruction: Make the container hold water for a short time.

tasks.title: Stabilize Bottle
tasks.summary: Stabilize a tube using dry sand in a bowl.
success_criteria: Tube's base is inside the bowl's footprint
Tube is upright (tilt <= 5 degrees from vertical)
Tube is stationary (low velocity)
Objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Make the tube stand upright in the bowl without falling for a short time.

tasks.title: Place Book
tasks.summary: Move the thin book onto the blue target mat without disturbing the heavy block.
success_criteria: Thin book is on the blue target mat (95% overlap)
Heavy block remains in place (displacement <= 10mm)
Book is free of heavy block (no overlap)
Objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Move the 'thin book' onto the 'blue target mat' without moving the heavy block from its place.

tasks.title: Raise Platform
tasks.summary: Place the heavy book on top of the cup supports.
success_criteria: Book is resting on both cup supports
Book is elevated above the table surface
Involved objects haven't fallen below the table
tasks.instruction: Place the book on the cup supports.

tasks.title: Water Into Mug
tasks.summary: Collect water in the mug using displacement.
success_criteria: At least 1 water particle is inside the mug's interior (circular proxy, z within mug bounds)
Mug remains within table XY bounds
Mug is resting on the table (not floating)
At least 70% of water particles remain over the table
tasks.instruction: Collect water in the mug without moving the pitcher.

tasks.title: Align Chopsticks
tasks.summary: Align six chopsticks so they all point in the same direction.
success_criteria: All six chopsticks have their thin ends pointing in the same direction
Chopsticks remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Make all six chopsticks point in the same direction, with their small thin ends all facing the same way.

tasks.title: Retrieve Roll
tasks.summary: Retrieve an out-of-reach roll using a long rod.
success_criteria: Roll overlaps target area by at least 50%
Roll remains within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Use the long rod to retrieve the out-of-reach roll and move it to the green target area.

tasks.title: Move Cube
tasks.summary: Move a cube past the goal line using slopes with different friction.
success_criteria: At least one cube has x > 0.9 (passes the goal line)
tasks.instruction: Move any of the three cubes to the left of the goal line.

tasks.title: Balance Board
tasks.summary: Balance a board on a narrow wall support.
success_criteria: Board is resting on top of the wall near its center
Board is balanced (nearly horizontal, not tipping/moving)
Objects remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Place the board onto the wall and keep it balanced.

tasks.title: Differentiate Cubes
tasks.summary: Differentiate wooden and metal cubes using buoyancy.
success_criteria: Wooden cube overlaps target area by at least 50%
Metal cube remains inside the mug
Cubes remain within table bounds
tasks.instruction: Place the wooden cube to the green target area. Keep the metal cube inside the mug.
